title: orb and meteor
why: Both are clean. Picked a: its orbs keep a tighter white-hot core at small sizes and its trail tapers to a thin end, which the rope needs.

title: fire burst
why: a reads as low domes from 40 degrees; b's middle frames stand up like balls. a's full burst touched the sheet edge and its last frame was loose flames, so one re-roll (an edit of a) moved the burst in and made the last frame a ring of embers: picked r2.

title: embers and sparks
why: Near twins. Picked a: thinner spark streaks and softer ember glows, which stay embers at a few pixels.

title: smoke
why: Picked a: more varied puffs and two separate columns; b's columns run into the sheet edge.

title: scorch decals
why: Picked a: its scorch is a ring with a lighter, burnt centre, as the storyboard asks; b's is a starburst splat.

title: thorns
why: Both grow well in four stages. Picked a: less key colour left in the art (0.11% against 1.18%) and a clearer ring variant for the eruption.

title: roots and vines
why: Picked a: coils that wrap a mound to knee height and a withered set that browns and falls apart; b keeps more key colour in the art (2.29%).

title: ground crack
why: Picked a: thinner crack strips with clean ends for the ropes, and a split-ground of radiating cracks (b's is a filled disc).

title: leaves, petals, flowers
why: Picked a: loose litter with no base; b's litter sits on a pink-fringed base and keeps more key colour.

title: roots and vines as open coils, back and front halves
why: Re-roll for the critique: open, see-through coils with separate back and front halves, so the man's legs are drawn between them. b paints exactly that (it laid its stages out in four rows, cut by their own grid), with dried and withering halves; a painted full baskets in each cell, a dead stump, and kept the guide's leg outlines. The generator tinted the dry roots mauve from the key: their hue is moved to ochre in the atlas.

title: heaved ground crack, keyed
why: Re-roll for the critique: a heaved furrow with sunlit clods that reads light, dark, light at 16 px, a crack head and clods, on magenta because multiply cannot show sunlit earth. a: the cleaner furrow and clods; both heads carry the key's pink in their dust, moved to a dry tan in the atlas.

title: fire burst frames 4 to 6 without smoke
why: Re-roll for the critique: frames 4 to 6 repainted with fire and embers only (the old frame 4's smoke read pink). a (an edit of E3.r2) keeps frames 1 to 3 and tears the dome open no wider than frame 3; b's frame 4 has a pale cream core that reads as steam.

title: flame mana ring and glyph
why: New for the critique: the flame ring with the game's flame glyph at its front, and the glyph alone. b: bolder tongues that read at play zoom and a glyph closer to the flame symbol; a's ring is a thin charred line.

title: leaf mana ring and glyph
why: New for the critique: a ring of leaves and young vines with the game's leaf glyph at its front, and the glyph alone. a: lighter, leafier and closer to "young vines"; b is a heavy woven wreath.
